nom: Olay Super Cream with Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.titre: Effective and worth the affordable price tag
avis.texte: I picked up a tiny bottle of the Olay Super Cream (the size of Clinique free w/purchase) and figured it was worth trying. I’m so glad that I did! It works extremely well. My skin is hydrated and looks great. I love that it has sunscreen included. The texture feels as though it is a whipped cream. It is not super heavy and not greasy. I’m getting older and regular daily Oil of Olay moisturizer was not doing anything for me anymore. It simply was not hydrating my skin. I’ve tried other moisturizers in the past and have had problems with all of them. Clinique moisturizers caused my skin to break out. Olay Regenerist made my skin feel as though it was on fire. It’s taken me a long time to find a moisturizer that works, feels good, and does not burn my skin. This one is the one I’ve been looking for. I find it effective and worth the affordable price tag. For reference, I’m in my 40’s, have very fair skin and freckles.

I love Olay products,I've never not tried something new and never loved it.. I've been using Olay for many years. When I 1st used it I was in middle school it was called oil of Olay and never had all the choices as they have today. But this super cream is my one of my favorites. But there is one down fall with this cream that I've never had any problems with any others is- is if it accidentally gets in your eyes it burns super bad..

I’m torn. One of the very few products I have that doesn’t burn my eyes is my Olay super serum. I have very fair sensitive skin and I struggle to find sunscreen that doesn’t burn. So I was excited to try this. However, it does burn my eyes. And when I first put it on it burns my whole face a little. But it calms down quickly. Great texture and easy to rub in. But yeah, just not hitting the mark for me to want to buy it again is all.

I have been trying all of the Olay moisturizers, and I’m really happy with this one. It goes on smooth, absorbs well, and protects my skin when I am working outside. My face feels nice and soft all day. Just right!

avis.titre: Absolutely love this Olay super cream!!
avis.texte: The super cream is amazing. I noticed a difference in my skin within the first week. Everyone wants instant gratification, but if you give this a minute, he will surely notice a difference in your skin. More hydrated, much more tone and just overall smoother complexion. I also love the body cream. Both products are truly amazing! Barely any smell as well very light. I hope this helps someone decide!

I thought I ordered UNSCENTED.. did not like the smell. Too floral.( I really don’t know if it was my mistake or not) texture ok but not as “ light” as I hoped.. I prob paid TOO much for a trial size.. however, by purchasing another item, which I did, I will receive a 10.00 credit within 30 days. Thanks, Amazon!
Nice smell goes on well and doesn't leave residue. I use this in the morning.

I've really enjoyed using this moisturizer It goies on easily and feels very nice. I realize the SPF factor is not good for a day in the sun. It does give some protection when going in and out of cars, stores. ets

avis.titre: Moisturizes well & has an SPF EXCELLENT!
avis.texte: So glad I was able to purchase the mini size. I wS thinking this might be the best new moisturizer for me. It is a great facial cream and having the SPF makes it even better. However, I have Korean face creams (bee venom and snail mucus) that are less expensive and better moisturizers. I like this one a lot but it's a little pricey. Try it please, you might love it! I'll stick with the truly Asian face creams.
Always a fan of Olay products, but especially with the SPF 30 added. Super creamy, velvety finish.

avis.titre: Good texture, absorbed well by my skin
avis.texte: I've been using Olay face cream for more than 3 years now (have very dry mature skin) & this Olay Super cream with SPF 30 is a big bonus because summer is coming. Love the texture of the cream & smell good too. I recommend to try it !!
Very small, but it’s actually nice for my skin. Wish it was bigger lol

Didn’t realize that for $37 this was only 15 mil thinking it was a 50 mil which was an error on my part . So I was surprised when it arrived and realized it’s only 15ml which is just tiny and I would never have paid that much, so I sent it back. I did find a 50ml for a good price from a different source. The cream is great so glad I was able to get it elsewhere . I shop quite a lot on Amazon and most things are very good value, but in this case not so. My advice, read all the fine print prior to ordering.

avis.titre: I love it, I have ordered more
avis.texte: This Olay product didn’t make tons of promises, but I decided to try it out. When I got the product, I was surprised that the directions on the box just treated it as if it is nothing more than a sunscreen. I don’t see much sun in the winter where I am, but went ahead and started applying it each morning. It is so light, easily blends into my face with no oiliness. Makes a definite improvement to my appearance, fine lines disappear. And it makes my face very soft throughout the day. It’s a very luxurious feel. I am in love with this and have ordered more. And it is indeed fragrance-free. I give it my highest recommendation.

I am a die hard fan of Olay Super Serum! So much so, that I will get my hands on anything from that line! I love the velvet feel it leaves on my face after application. I use it after I use the Super Serum and I've noticed significant improvements in my skin. My face is glowing, its hydrated and so soft! Nothing could make me hate Olay Super Serum line! 😍😍😍

Purchase this product maybe a month and a 1/2 ago I still have half a jar left to go I use it every day as part of my daily routine. It makes my face nice soft moisture works perfectly under my makeup. I'm so glad I found this. It has changed my morning routine in half time. One bottle all in 1❤️

I don’t usually like cream with sunscreen but this one I like. It’s not too heavy. The reason I was drawn to write a review is the scent. It smells sooooo good. Relaxing clean pleasing scent. Skin feels smooth, make up goes on flawlessly.
Love this product and the light scent, too. Outer box was a nightmare to open - the cardboard is so thick! Had to even use a hammer.

I love this cream! The texture is amazing and it has made a huge difference in my skin. I’m also on a weight loss journey and my first pic is from a few months ago. But I just started using this cream religiously about a month ago and my skin looks so much healthier already. Recently added the super serum at night as well.

This is a very think cream, a tiny bit goes a long way. It has a scent that reminds me of suntan lotion. My skin is sensitive and after using it daily for 2 weeks, I haven’t experienced any negative reactions, but I don’t apply it full strength. I tried the first time I did, but it felt too heavy, so I washed it off and placed a pea size amount in my palm, added about the same amount of filtered water - mixed it together and then applied it. That worked out fine, so I’ve been applying it the same way daily. While I may be decreasing the SPF strength, it does moisturize and make my skin look brighter and softer.

I received this Olay super cream with sunscreen. It has niacinamide and peptides plus 30 SPF sunscreen. I think one of the nice things about this is it’s a trusted brand. Olay is recognizable and I have used their products in the past. The box is easy to decipher and done well. The cream itself is unscented, though there is a very faint scent. I think with skincare products that have sunscreen it’s hard to achieve completely scent free, but this is the closest I’ve used. It’s virtually unscented. The cream is luxurious feeling as it seems almost whipped. My only complaint is you do have to work this product in to get the cream to not leave white residue, again, sunscreen at 30SPF. Even then it’s a minimal complaint as I think I’d take the 30SPF to work it in more. Overall it left my skin feeling moisturized all morning. I think anyone would be happy with this product if they are looking for skincare with built in SPF, especially considering it’s virtually scent free.

This Olay Super Cream is thick, creamy and has a luxurious consistency. I love how it absorbs well into my skin leaving it feel hydrated and happy. It does have a slight sunscreen scent and feel but that dissipates quickly. This moisturizer is lightweight and makeup applies well over top of it. It doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin and I’m very happy with the results and natural ingredients use. For the current price of $35 I feel is a fair value. Olay is a trusted brand and I like that it’s affordable.

The Olay Super Cream with Sunscreen SPF 30 is a rich, nourishing moisturizer that also provides reliable sun protection. It absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, leaving skin soft and hydrated. The SPF 30 helps shield the skin from harmful UV rays, making it perfect for daily use. Its creamy formula feels luxurious and soothing, ideal for normal to dry skin. Overall, it’s a convenient, effective skincare product that combines hydration and sun protection in one.

This Olay Super Cream has been a great addition to my daily skincare routine. It comes from a trusted brand and truly does what it claims. The texture is lightweight and absorbs well without feeling greasy or heavy, which is especially important for a moisturizer that includes SPF. I really appreciate that it’s fragrance-free, exactly as listed. It feels gentle on the skin and hasn’t caused any irritation. The finish is smooth and comfortable, giving a healthy, polished look without shine or residue. I can confidently say the SPF has been doing its job - I haven’t had any sunburn issues so far (though to be fair it is still winter at this time =]). Overall, this is a reliable, effective, and convenient product that combines skincare and sun protection in one step. I’m very happy with it and would absolutely continue using it.

avis.titre: Simple, Gentle Sunscreen Cream That Works for Me
avis.texte: I really like this cream so far. The texture is light and fluffy, which makes it really easy to apply. It does feel a little oily right when you put it on, but it absorbs pretty quickly. I’m also pretty sure I used way too much the first time…it’s definitely a “dime-sized amount” kind of lotion. The extra I rubbed onto the backs of my hands, and that actually felt really nice. My skin didn’t get irritated at all, which is huge for me. The scent is basically classic sunscreen…not perfumey, just that familiar SPF smell, which I don’t mind. I love that it has SPF 30 because I’ve been wanting something simple to use every morning, and this fits perfectly into my routine. I don’t wear makeup, but I did work out after putting it on, and I didn’t feel extra oily or slick during my workout. So that’s a big plus. The value is a little higher than I usually like to spend, but honestly, because you really only need a small amount each day, I think the bottle will last long enough to make it worth it. All in all, I’m happy with it and will definitely keep using it as my daily SPF moisturizer.

avis.titre: Olay Super Cream with Sunscreen Helped Me Speed Up Morning Skincare Routine
avis.texte: In the morning, I layer a lot of different skincare products, but with Olay Super Cream, I can do it all in just one step. This light smooth cream has it all: Niacinamide, Vitamin C, Collagen, Vitamin E and Hyaluronic Acid and to top it all off, a broad spectrum sun screen with an SPF of 30. One and done! The Olay Super Cream is creamy and easy to apply; a quick massage and it thoroughly absorbs, leaving a soft matte finish. It comes in two varieties regular and unscented, the one i received. I think it is just about perfect!

Im no specialist on using skin creams or lotions but this out of the box am suprized. Packaged and labeled well and a very thick creamy structure it doesnt take alot as i learned the hard way first time. Use to much and its a bit greasy feeling but thats expected till it absorbs. As far as washing off it doesnt come off instantly which is a plus especially if using as a sun protectant. Works good for dry skin as well or flaky skin.

avis.titre: Feels very light, moisturizing, SPF, reducing fine line!
avis.texte: This super cream from Olay is perfect! The cream works as a daily moisturizer and SPF at the same time. It has a great texture that feels very light on the skin. It doesn’t feel heavy at all and it is very easily absorbed. I used the cream for three days now and I already feel my face is softer with almost no effort. I only use facial wash then apply this cream anyway even if I am not planning to leave the house this day. The cream is very soft. It also helps reduce the fine lines although I still haven’t seen this yet on my skin but I think it might on the long term since I already feel my skin a little tighter after applying it. Overall I am so happy with it and I recommend it.

This Olay Super Fragrance free Cream with Sunscreen arrived packaged well and in excellent condition. This Olay Super Cream arrived on the date and time promised when the original order was placed. This cream works to restore troubled skin and tighten wrinkled areas. The Olay Super Cream starts working as soon as it is applied to the skin you can feel the effects right away and see the smoother areas in which it was applied. It is not oily goes on easily and protects me from the sun for up to two hours. If you need to refresh your skin and protect it in the sun I would definitely recommend this Olay Super Cream.

The Olay Super Cream with SPF 30 is fantastic! It’s lightweight, fragrance-free, and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. I love that it combines hydration, brightening, firming, and sun protection in one step, makes my morning routine so easy. The addition of Niacinamide, Vitamin C, and Collagen makes my skin feel nourished and healthier over time. My face looks brighter, feels soft, and has better elasticity since I started using it. Perfect for daily use, especially if you want a simple, effective all-in-one moisturizer with sun protection.

avis.titre: Great unscented face cream with SPF
avis.texte: High Quality face cream. Has SPF, feels very lightweight, and is unscented. Under the cap is a protector that keeps lotion in place and out of the lid. Looks nice and feels great!
This face cream keep my face skin very moisturized love how it’s feel super soft after use this is a must have definitely awesome

The Olay Super Cream with Sunscreen SPF 30 comes with amazing ingredients such as Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, Vitamin E, and Collagen Peptide all of which my skin loves! The cream itself is lightweight, very little scent, and goes on smoothly. It absorbed well and even better no white cast which some sunscreens tend to do. Honestly I am surprised at how much SPF is in this moisturizer.

Goes on smoothly. I have used this a bunch of times now and it seems to be working well with my skin. It goes on smoothly and I have not experienced any irritation. Even though this is a small container, a little goes a long way so it still lasts for a long time. It does have a scent to it. I usually prefer unscented lotions, but the scent of this is pleasant and not too strong so I actually enjoy it. I have also used this on my kids' faces a few times as sunscreen, since it has broad spectrum spf 30 in it.

avis.titre: Very full jar, excellent moisturizer from Olay but extremely high priced.
avis.texte: This is a very potent deep moisturizer for daytime. There's a massive amount of sunscreen, which I can see and feel on my face, but the skincare base in here is very elegant, and the white thick cream completely disappears into my skin without a trace. I never rely on my moisturizer for sunscreen though! I always apply an additional sunscreen on top! My jar was insanely full, see how much cream was on the top seal. You need three pea sized dollops to moisturize your face, then apply your normal sunscreen for full protection. This jar will last 3 months for me. Love things to note is that I'm disappointed that an Olay product is costing $35. Drugstore is becoming prohibitively expensive these days.

avis.titre: Absorbs quickly, non-greasy, and no white cast
avis.texte: Olay Super Cream with Sunscreen SPF 30 is a lightly scented cream that glides on easily and absorbs quickly providing a non-greasy matte finish that doesn't pill under my foundation. The cream uses four chemical sunscreen agents that protect against UVA/UVB sun damage, and it doesn't leave a white cast. I've had basal cell already, so this is very important for me. I like how well hydrated it makes my skin feel, and it also helps to even out my skin tone. The directions say to apply the cream 15 minutes before sun exposure, and to reapply at least every 2 hours. Use water resistant sunscreen if swimming or sweating.

This cream is absolutely awesome, I love the fact that it’s hybrid cream, meaning it’s includes spf yet doesn’t feel sunsceeny at all. Best part of course the fact that little goes along way and I can just eliminate one layer of product on my face. It’s definitely hydrating, soaks up fairly quickly and lives my skin hydrated and glowing all day including protecting it from sun. Very high quality and absolutely amazing, very happy with results and most definitely super cream that I will continue to use!

The packaging is very good quality and the cream is scented. The cream feels velvety unlike other sunscreens I have used. It doesn’t leave a white cast or greasy residue on the skin. I like that it’s SPF 30 and that I can use this as my moisturizer and sunscreen in the morning saving me a step in my morning skincare routine.

avis.titre: Misleading Packaging – Very Little Product Inside
avis.texte: I’m very disappointed with this Olay cream. The outer jar is large and gives the impression that you’re getting a good amount of product, but inside there’s a much smaller inner container—and even that container is not fully filled. This feels very misleading. The packaging makes it look like you’re getting more cream than you actually are, which comes across as deceptive marketing. When I opened it, it honestly felt like I was being scammed. For the price, I expected much better transparency and value. The product itself may be fine, but the packaging and underfilled container completely ruin the experience. I would not buy this again unless they fix the packaging and clearly match the product amount to the container size. And I am going to give a one star for this product

avis.titre: It did not work for my dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am glad I tried this cream on my day off, because I ended up washing my face. I have very dry and sensitive skin. This cream made my skin itchy, and the hydration did not last for more than two hours. I reapplied it a few more times throughout the day to give it a chance, but I gave up and washed my face and used my ice roller to calm my skin. I don't know what ingredient caused the itchiness, but it felt awful. Also, if it gets in the eyes, it burns really bad.
This was not sealed in any way. I do not feel safe when a product that I put on my face is not sealed. It is an issue of safety.
Applies nicely to the face. Does not have a greasy feel. Works well with Olay’s Super Serum. Added bonus is that it has a SPF of 30. Can also be used as a primer before you apply your makeup .
Love it!! Not runny and feels good on skin! Finally found a moisturizer that has spf but no white sunscreen residue! Smells good too!

avis.titre: Moisturizer with Sunscreen!!! A NO NO
avis.texte: I’ve been using OilOf Olay products since I was 14, I am 70 and can assure you they are the best products ever.They really keep your complexion and your skin looking so much younger with very little wrinkles.But….. every time I’ve bought and put on any of their products that have sunscreen on them I have to wash it off immediately since the ingredients hurt and burn if they get in your eyes.It happens with Every moisturizer with Sunscreen ..Will not buy anymore of those.

Compré está crema hace una semana y empeze aplicarla sobre mi rostro, al tercer día me levanté con mis párpados inchados y mi rostro enrojecido junto con una especie de ronchas y picazón por toda mi cara, llevo con estos síntomas más de una semana y me preocupa están empezando día a día, sugiero no comprar esta crema.

I have used oil of Olay since I was younger I got this one with same excitement as all my other oil Olay products and this product burned my face I’m not sure what happened still total shock that I have paid so much for this cream and now have dermatologist bills helping with the situation wish someone would have replied my emails about my questions

I've been really happy with this Olay Super Cream. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day without feeling greasy. The SPF 30 is a great bonus for daily sun protection, and I love that it's fragrance-free, making it gentle on sensitive skin. A convenient all-in-one product for my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Velvety moisturizer, but has a distinct sunscreen smell
avis.texte: I love that Oil of Olay added a fragrance-free version of Super Cream. That being said, I was a bit surprised to open the jar and be met with such a strong sunscreen smell. In fact, it was strong enough that I actually looked at the box and jar to see if I had gotten a standard sunscreen instead of a moisturizer with sunscreen. Aside from that, the cream itself is definitely moisturizing, with more of matte finish than a dewy finish; on my skin, it has a velvety finish that feels like a really nice makeup primer. As such, it works very well under makeup, and I don’t feel like it makes my foundation ‘slide’ off my face. I really like these aspects of it, but I’ve found myself not wanting to use it if I’m going to be near very many people (like a dinner or holiday party), because I feel like I smell noticeably like sunscreen. I’ve been using it primarily when I’m running errands or just going to be outside around the house. While it feels nice on my skin, the sunscreen smell limits when I’m comfortable wearing it, so the current price point of over $20 per ounce make it a product I just can’t justify adding to my daily routine. There are other products, including some within the Oil of Olay brand, that provide similar benefits at a much better value. When you factor in that it has to be applied every 2 hours to provide adequate SPF (like any other sunscreen), it makes it an even less practical option for me personally.

This itty-bitty Olay Super Cream comes in a beautiful iridescent container. The Super Cream is very thick, kind of like cold cream, but it’s non-greasy and absorbs into my skin almost immediately. It gives my skin a youthful shimmer. It feels very luxurious.
